formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x3 : ℕ) (x4 : Bool),   PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo { gates := [x1], output := (0 : ℕ) : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit } →     PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x2 →       x2.size ≤ (17 : ℕ) →         have x8 : (Fin (10 : ℕ) → Bool) → Bool := fun (x8 : Fin (10 : ℕ) → Bool) => x8 (0 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) && x8 (1 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) || x8 (1 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) && x8 (2 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) || x8 (2 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) && x8 (3 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) || x8 (3 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) && x8 (4 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) || x8 (4 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) && x8 (0 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) || x8 (0 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) && x8 (5 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) || x8 (1 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) && x8 (6 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) || x8 (2 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) && x8 (7 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) || x8 (3 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) && x8 (8 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) || x8 (4 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) && x8 (9 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) || x8 (5 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) && x8 (7 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) || x8 (7 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) && x8 (9 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) || x8 (9 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) && x8 (6 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) || x8 (6 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) && x8 (8 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) || x8 (8 : Fin (10 : ℕ)) && x8 (5 : Fin (10 : ℕ));         have x9 : (Fin (10 : ℕ) → Bool) → ℕ → Bool := fun (x9 : Fin (10 : ℕ) → Bool) (x10 : ℕ) => (x2.wires ({ gates := [x1], output := (0 : ℕ) : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit }.wires (List.ofFn x9))).getD x10 Bool.false;         ∃ (x10 : Fin (10 : ℕ) → Bool), (if x4 = Bool.true then !x9 x10 x3 else x9 x10 x3) ≠ x8 x10)
plain_statement: It is false that: Petersen graph as in the parent, F its edge function on 10 inputs. Take any fan-in-two gate g on the 10 inputs and any AND/OR/NOT fan-in-two circuit of at most 17 gates reading the 10 inputs and the wire of g: no wire of it equals F, and no wire equals NOT F.
title: It is false that: A step toward: Petersen graph: no circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 19 gates computes its edge function
